mapper.select: INSERT INTO beat_instance ( run_id, seq, source, asset_id, arc_id, arc_seg_no, beat_type, pacing, chapter_no, volume_no, filled_text, status, beat_key, chapter_seq, pack_version, novelty_key, story_layer, beat_role, route_contract ) VALUES ( #{p.runId}, #{p.seq}, #{p.source}, #{p.assetId}, #{p.arcId}, #{p.arcSegNo}, #{p.beatType}, #{p.pacing}, #{p.chapterNo}, #{p.volumeNo}, #{p.filledText}, #{p.status}, #{p.beatKey}, #{p.chapterSeq}, #{p.packVersion}, #{p.noveltyKey}, #{p.storyLayer}, #{p.beatRole}, #{p.routeContract}::jsonb ) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE beat_instance SET chapter_no = #{p.chapterNo}, volume_no = #{p.volumeNo}, filled_text = #{p.filledText}, status = #{p.status}, story_layer = #{p.storyLayer}, beat_role = #{p.beatRole}, route_contract = #{p.routeContract}::jsonb, beat_key = #{p.beatKey}, chapter_seq = #{p.chapterSeq}, pack_version = #{p.packVersion}, novelty_key = #{p.noveltyKey}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{p.id}
UPDATE beat_instance SET filled_text = #{filledText}, status = #{status}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE beat_instance SET status = #{status}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE beat_instance SET filled_text = NULL, status = 'PLANNED', updated_time = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId}
